component.name: Marker
component.summary: Powerful markdown editor for the GNOME desktop

description.p: Marker is a fast and powerful markdown editor designed for the GNOME desktop with real-time preview and document export capabilities.

ul.li: View and edit markdown documents
Convert markdown documents to HTML
Tex math rendering
Support for mermaid diagrams
Support for charter plots
Syntax highlighting for code blocks
Integrated sketch editor
Exports to PDF, RTF, ODT, DOCx and LaTeX
Custom CSS themes
Custom syntax themes
Figure captioning and numbering
New bundled preview themes "Fedora Dark" and "Fedora Light" built on official GNOME/libadwaita surface tokens and the Fedora brand blue accent (#51a2da).
New bundled highlight.js themes "adwaita" and "adwaita-dark" matching the GtkSourceView Adwaita / Adwaita-dark editor schemes, so preview code blocks and the editor share the same colors.
GNOME HIG compliance: AdwToolbarView, AdwSplitButton, AdwViewSwitcher, AdwViewStack, AdwShortcutsDialog, GtkColorDialogButton.
Sidebar documents list migrated from GtkTreeView to GtkListBox with inline rename/close buttons.
Fixed crash on startup caused by incorrect AdwViewPage class name in UI file.
Added missing languages to LINGUAS (ko, pt_BR, zh_CN).
Desktop file: added StartupWMClass, StartupNotify, DBusActivatable, TextEditor category.
Removed non-functional Help menu item and dead app.help action.
Single fullscreen toggle button in the headerbar.
Split save button with floppy icon and dropdown (Save, Save As, Export).
Rename button (pencil icon) in the sidebar next to the close button.
Sidebar always hidden at startup; auto-shows with 2+ documents.
Fixed GtkStack name collision when reopening a closed file.
Fixed sidebar icon click detection using bin-window coordinates.
Removed redundant items from the hamburger menu.
Removed the non-functional Help menu entry.
Hard fork under Nathan Obry (thenathattify). App-ID rebranded to com.github.thenathattify.marker.
Interactive GFM task list checkboxes in the live preview.
Reworked zoom UX: per-pane Ctrl+scroll, editable zoom field, fit-to-width button.
GTK4 regression fixes: view-mode crash, menu loading order, blank preview, fullscreen state, cursor position.
Automatic settings migration from com.github.adrighem.marker schemas.
Modernized user interface with GTK 4 and Libadwaita.
Ported live preview to WebKitGTK 6.0.
Added document outline navigation in the sidebar.
Added Find and Replace controller.
Added automatic draft caching and recovery.
Added option to trim trailing whitespace on save.
Fixed a bug where equations weren't being rendered properly.
Improved localizations.
Preview stick to the editing text better.
Fixed crash on file opening.
Added the ability to choose any view mode when launching from cli.
Added ability to export documents from the cli.
Added vim-like shortcuts (h,j,k,l,g,G) to the previewer.
Added the ability to choose any view mode when launching from cli.
Fixed a glitch where documents opened in preview mode were scrolled to the bottom.
Fixed a glitch causing two appmenus to appear in non-gnome environments.
Fixed a glitch where code blocks didn't have monospaced font in the preview with some themes.
Added right-to-left language support
Added support for beamer classes for making presentations
Users can choose between KaTeX math rendering (faster), or MathJax math rendering.
